records.source: You may enter.
records.translation: Maaari kang pumasok.

records.source: The objective is to get as close to 21 as possible. Cards range from 1 to 9, except for the first card which can be as high as 11. Each player starts with two cards, but the dealer's first card remains hidden. Each turn you can choose to draw a random number between 1 and 9 or pass.
records.translation: Ang layunin ay makakuha ng bilang na pinakamalapit sa 21. Ang halaga ng mga baraha ay mula 1 hanggang 9, maliban sa unang baraha na maaaring umabot sa 11. Magsisimula ang bawat manlalaro sa dalawang baraha, ngunit mananatiling nakatago ang unang baraha ng dealer. Sa bawat turno, maaari kang bumunot ng sapalarang bilang mula 1 hanggang 9 o tumigil.

records.source: Once you pass, the dealer's hidden card is revealed. She must draw until her total reaches or exceeds 18. If either player exceeds 21 on their turn, they lose. If the dealer passes, then all cards are revealed and the highest score wins.
records.translation: Kapag tumigil ka, ibubunyag ang nakatagong baraha ng dealer. Kailangan niyang bumunot hanggang umabot o lumampas sa 18 ang kabuuan niya. Kapag lumampas sa 21 ang alinmang manlalaro sa kaniyang turno, matatalo siya. Kapag tumigil ang dealer, ibubunyag ang lahat ng baraha at mananalo ang may pinakamataas na puntos.

records.source: You need at least 1000 coins to play here.
records.translation: Kailangan mo ng hindi bababa sa 1000 barya para makapaglaro rito.

records.source: Hey, the betting's fixed at 100 coins. You don't have enough. Go buy some coins from the machine if you want to play.
records.translation: Hoy, nakatakda sa 100 barya ang pusta. Kulang ang mga barya mo. Bumili ka ng mga barya sa makina kung gusto mong maglaro.

records.source: I can increase the size of your house and add a kitchen. It will cost 10,000g and you'll also need to provide me with 450 pieces of wood. Are you interested?
records.translation: Maaari kong palakihin ang bahay mo at dagdagan ito ng kusina. Aabot ito sa 10,000g at kailangan mo rin akong bigyan ng 450 piraso ng kahoy. Interesado ka ba?

records.source: I can increase the size of your house and add a nursery. It will cost {0}g and you'll also need to provide me with {1} pieces of hardwood. Are you interested?
records.translation: Maaari kong palakihin ang bahay mo at dagdagan ito ng silid para sa bata. Aabot ito sa {0}g at kailangan mo rin akong bigyan ng {1} piraso ng Matigas na Kahoy. Interesado ka ba?

records.source: I can add a cellar to your house. The cellar can be used to age certain products, like wine and cheese. It will cost 100,000g. Are you interested?
records.translation: Maaari akong magdagdag ng silong sa bahay mo. Magagamit ang silong para pahinugin ang ilang produkto, gaya ng alak at keso. Aabot ito sa 100,000g. Interesado ka ba?

records.source: ...What's that? You want to build Pam a house? That's a great idea!^I'll just need 950 wood and 500,000g...
records.translation: ...Ano iyon? Gusto mong ipagpatayo ng bahay si Pam? Magandang ideya iyan!^Kailangan ko lang ng 950 kahoy at 500,000g...

records.source: Sorry... You have the money, but I also need {0} pieces of wood.
records.translation: Paumanhin... May pera ka, pero kailangan ko rin ng {0} piraso ng kahoy.

records.source: Sorry... You have the money, but I also need {0} pieces of hardwood.
records.translation: Paumanhin... May pera ka, pero kailangan ko rin ng {0} piraso ng Matigas na Kahoy.

records.source: The spreading weeds have caused damage to your farm.
records.translation: Napinsala ng kumakalat na mga damo ang bukid mo.

records.source: If you become a Joja Member, the community center will become a Joja Warehouse, and you will no longer be able to refurbish it. However, Joja will provide an alternative means to improving the town. Are you sure you want to join?
records.translation: Kapag naging Miyembro ka ng Joja, magiging Bodega ng Joja ang Sentro ng Komunidad at hindi mo na ito maipapaayos. Gayunman, magbibigay ang Joja ng ibang paraan para mapabuti ang bayan. Sigurado ka bang gusto mong sumali?
